primary_outcome: False not applicable prediction among expert not excluded annotations
primary_comparison: Paired difference in false-NA rate: baseline minus ablated

evaluation_rules: Use identical cases in both prompt conditions

Do not discard valid predictions because they disagree with expert labels
Report malformed or missing responses separately
Do not treat repeated calls as independent patients
